name: Vald Self-Hosted Vector Search
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source distributed approximate nearest-neighbor vector search with automatic indexing, replication and backup; no vendor-imposed index, query or vector quota for self-hosting.
watch_out: Kubernetes and AVX2-capable CPUs are required for the documented NGT agent. Infrastructure, object storage and operations are not free; Vald focuses on dense-vector similarity rather than keyword search.
